claim: Supabase Storage signed upload URLs (createSignedUploadUrl) are valid for 2 hours
evidence: https://supabase.com/docs/reference/javascript/storage-from-createsigneduploadurl : 'They are valid for 2 hours.' (fetched 2026-10-07). The 5-minute limit the upload hits is the app's own ticket (media_library.sql:107), not Storage's.

claim: «لا يحتفظ Supabase المجاني بأي نسخة» (the Free plan keeps no backup of the project)
evidence: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/backups (fetched 2026-10-07): daily backups are listed for Pro (7 days), Team (14) and Enterprise (30); for free projects the page recommends that they 'regularly export their data using the Supabase CLI db dump command and maintain off-site backups'.

claim: Resend domain verification on Cloudflare: DKIM/SPF records (TXT and MX or CNAME), no Cloudflare proxy on the CNAME, usually minutes and up to 72 hours
evidence: https://resend.com/docs/knowledge-base/cloudflare (fetched 2026-10-07): MX for mail routing, TXT for SPF, TXT for DKIM; 'Confirm your proxy settings are set to DNS Only on the record you are adding'; 'It may take up to 72 hours to complete the verification process (often much faster).' The CNAME mention is broader than Resend's minimum set but not wrong (a proxied CNAME is what the DNS-only advice is about).

claim: auth-js signOut removes the local session even when the server call fails
evidence: Installed @supabase/auth-js 2.117.1 (node_modules/.pnpm/@supabase+auth-js@2.117.1/.../GoTrueClient.js): _signOut removes the session after a failed server sign-out (3439-3450), but returns early without removing it when the session cannot be loaded (3433-3436), which __loadSession reports for an expired access token whose refresh failed with a retryable error (2549-2573; _callRefreshToken keeps the session for AuthRetryableFetchError, catch branch). Verified in the installed package source, not vendor docs.
